          </label>

            id="water-admin-code"
            type="password"
            autoComplete="current-password"
            value={accessCode}

          <button
            type="submit"

          >
            {loading ? "Έλεγχος…" : "Σύνδεση ως Administrator"}
          </button>
        </form>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}
